function.name: list_mailboxes
function.description: List all configured mailboxes. Returns their addresses plus read/write capability flags.

function.name: list_emails
function.description: List emails with optional filters. Use mailbox to scope to a specific address, unread_only to only return unread messages, search for content-based filtering, and limit to control result count.

mailbox.description: Filter by mailbox address (e.g. 'robin@evonic.dev'). Leave empty to list across all mailboxes.

unread_only.description: When true, only return unread emails.

search.description: Search term to filter emails by subject or body content.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default 20, max 100.

function.name: get_email
function.description: Fetch a single email by its ID. Returns full content including headers, body, and attachments metadata.

email_id.description: The unique ID of the email to retrieve.

function.name: send_email
function.description: Send a new email from one of your configured mailboxes. Supports plain text or HTML body, plus CC and BCC recipients.

from_mailbox.description: The mailbox address to send from (e.g. 'robin@evonic.dev'). Must be a configured mailbox with write capability.

body.description: Email body content. Can be plain text or HTML.

cc.description: CC recipient email address (optional, single address).

bcc.description: BCC recipient email address (optional, single address).

function.name: reply_email
function.description: Reply to an existing email. The reply will be threaded to the original message using the in-reply-to header.

email_id.description: The ID of the email to reply to.

body.description: Reply body content. Can be plain text or HTML.

reply_all.description: When true, reply to all recipients (Reply-All). When false or omitted, reply only to the sender.

function.name: delete_email
function.description: Move an email to the trash. This is a soft delete — the email is not permanently removed immediately.

email_id.description: The ID of the email to delete.
